clips.send: A parent sends this to the one who still drinks straight from the tap without a second thought - anxiety about what's actually getting into their family's water.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau points to a discovery that shocked researchers: water supplies across the U.S. were tested and came back with real traces of pharmaceutical drugs.

His view: because your skin absorbs water in the shower just like your stomach absorbs it when you drink, a whole-house filter matters as much as a drinking filter.

He also flags a newer finding in that same water: nanoparticles shed from plastics, which he ties to falling testosterone levels.

His fix: filter what reaches your body before it gets there.

clips.send: A shopper sends this to the friend who trusts anything labeled 'natural' at the store - anger at realizing the word means nothing at all.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau says the first lie on most packages is the word shoppers trust the most: "natural."

His view: "all natural" carries no real weight - a package can say it and still hide dozens of additives.

His breakdown of the organic tiers: "made with organic ingredients" can mean as little as 10% organic, plain "organic" around 80%, and only "100% organic" gets you close to the real thing.

His rule: skip the first two and look for "100% organic" specifically.

Which word on your pantry shelf have you never actually checked?

#kevintrudeau #readthelabel #allnatural #organicfood #foodtruth #wbdaily

clips.send: A shopper sends this to the friend who always flips the bag over now - satisfaction at finally having the full checklist.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau runs through his own ingredient checklist: anything with soy, corn or corn syrup, hydrogenated oil, canola oil, no "non-GMO" claim, monosodium glutamate, aspartame or sucralose.

His rule: any one of those on the label, and the product goes back on the shelf.

His one exception: wheat and gluten, unless the label says "product of Italy" - he says that wheat is fermented far longer, which is easier on digestion.

How many items in your pantry would survive this checklist?

#kevintrudeau #readthelabel #foodadditives #msg #aspartame #wbdaily

clips.send: A guy sends this to the gym buddy chasing testosterone supplements - the plot twist that the real fix might just be dinner.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau says the testosterone fix most men overlook isn't a supplement - it's the beef itself.

His view: 100% grass-fed beef, from calves that never touched grain, carries far more CLA than regular beef, and CLA is tied to raising testosterone.

His story: a friend came back from three weeks in Argentina eating grass-fed beef daily and said he felt like a different person - more energy, better sleep, more drive.

His rule: look past "grass-fed" alone and look for "100% grass-fed," since the label rules let regular beef wear the same words.

What does the beef in your fridge actually eat?

clips.send: Someone sends this to the friend who still swears old McDonald's fries tasted better - the satisfying 'I told you so' about why.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau explains why McDonald's fries used to taste better: they were cooked in beef fat, not the canola, soybean and hydrogenated oils used today.

His view: beef fat, duck fat and pork lard carry a high "flash point," so you can fry hot without the oil breaking down and going rancid the way seed oils do.

His own kitchen rule: fry in those traditional fats - from grass-fed or organic animals when he can - for both the taste and the health.
